comment: A design for tools/ui-scripts/drawing-large-view.mitcad-ui (mitcad#1997): many bodies, as a large design's drawing has. Sketch1's circle of radius 8 at the origin on XY extruded as high as the parameter height (20 mm), Body1 (F2.b0), and a rectangular pattern of it, 6 along X and 6 along Y, 25 mm apart (F3): 36 cylinders, x and y -8 to 133, z 0 to the height. Drawing1 (D1, A3) has their front view (view 1) at 1:1 in the polygonal style (a projection from a triangulation, which a new scale projects again) with its box's middle at (150, 150): x 79.5 to 220.5 and y 140 to 160 on the sheet. The UI test holds each projection of its jobs 3 s (MITCAD_TEST_RECOMPUTE_DELAY_MS), as a large design's takes. All geometry is synthetic.
